title: Speedy Vegan Pumpkin Ravioli
subtitle: with Tomato and Oregano Sauce
description: Five easy steps, minimal pans and prep… we cut the fluff but not the flavour in our speedy recipes. In just 20 minutes, you’ll have this masterpiece on the table and be crowned in glory too!

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Peel the pumpkin and cut into 2cm chunks. Finely chop the onion. Pick the oregano leaves, discarding the stems. Put the pumpkin and 1 tbs water in a microwave-safe bowl, cover and microwave for 5 mins or until tender (see Cooking tip).

Soften onion: Meanwhile, bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil for the ravioli. Heat a generous drizzle of olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat. Cook the onion, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened.

Make sauce: Increase the heat to medium-high and add the tomatoes, pumpkin, half the oregano, 3 tsp pepper and garlic seasoning (see Kitchen notes), 60ml (¼ cup) plant-based milk and 1 tbs tomato paste to the onion. Cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined. Remove from the heat. Blend the tomato mixture with a stick blender or food processor until smooth (see Kitchen notes).

Cook ravioli: Cook the ravioli in the pan of boiling water for 3 mins or until al dente. Drain. Add the ravioli to the sauce and gently stir over medium heat until the ravioli is coated and the sauce is warmed through. Remove the pan from the heat. Taste, then season with salt and pepper.
Serve up: Divide the ravioli among bowls and scatter over the remaining oregano. Enjoy!

Kitchen notes: Our pepper and garlic seasoning has a mild peppery kick, so reduce the amount if you prefer less heat. ~ If you don't have a stick blender or food processor, mash the tomato mixture with a potato masher. The result won't be as smooth but it will be just as delicious!
